tools.name: get_page_contents
tools.description: Fetch a public web page live and return its main content as clean Markdown, plain text or HTML. Use this when you have a specific URL and need its current content. Works best on articles, docs, product and listing pages. Does not log in, submit forms or execute JavaScript (yet).

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Check the remaining credits, plan and rate limit for the connected SiteRender API account. Use before large batches of fetches.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_page_contents · Public sink: get_page_contents · Destructive: get_page_contents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_page_contents · Public sink: get_page_contents · Destructive: get_page_contents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
